# EngineScatterChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasEngineScatterChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasEngineScatterChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasEngineScatterChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasEngineScatterChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartEngineElement`](UltraCanvasChartEngineElement.md) → [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Any of the charts above **on the chart engine** — themes, measured layout, solved labels, tooltips, Vertical / Horizontal / Polar — compared with the legacy ones on the demo's *Chart Engine Comparison* page (`UltraCanvasEngineCharts.md`)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasEngineScatterChart> CreateEngineScatterChart( const std::string& id, int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 0, int h = 0);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasEngineScatterChart(const std::string& id, int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 0, int h = 0);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

### struct `EngineScatterPoint`

### struct `EngineScatterGroup`

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `std::string name` |  |
| `points` | `std::vector<EngineScatterPoint> points` |  |
| `color` | `Color color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)` | alpha 0 = take it from the theme palette |
| `marker` | `ChartMarkerShape marker = ChartMarkerShape::Circle` |  |
| `joined` | `bool joined = false` | Joined: a straight line through the group's points in the order they are given (an office scatter chart "with lines": each series over its own x values, which need not rise). A point that is not finite breaks the line. Off by default - a scatter chart shows points. |
| `lineWidth` | `float lineWidth = 0.0f` | 0 = the chart's SetJoinLineWidth |
| `smooth` | `bool smooth = false` | A joined group's line as a smooth curve through its points (a centripetal Catmull-Rom spline: it follows the points in their order whichever way they run, and does not loop or overshoot between them). |
| `showMarkers` | `bool showMarkers = true` | false = no marks, the line alone (hover, tooltips and labels stay). |

### enum `EngineBubbleScale`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Area` | value proportional to the circle's area (the honest default) |
| `Diameter` | value proportional to the diameter (exaggerates differences) |
